title: Metal Detector
body:
"Harnessing the long ago powers discovered deep underneath Ookspace 46, you can now see nearby ores and slates nearby with ease!"

Description

The Metal Detector is an item used to see what ores are present in rock nodes. Upon getting close enough to an ore node, it will display which ore is present in the node above it in a text bubble. It costs $32,500 and can be found at Gizmo's Observatory in the Snowlands.

Appearance

Metal Detector, appears to look like an old phone, despite the name, does not look like a traditional metal detector like you would see someone using on the beach, also has what looks like Wi-Fi signals coming out of it.

Trivia

  • The Metal Detector was added on December 1st of 2024, along with the Christmas update.
  • Despite the Metal Detector seeming like a really useful item, the ability to only see ores while you are holding it and you having to be close up to the ores makes it less useful.
